headline: Why are Tourism Holdings Shares Up Today? - The Bull
summary: Tourism Holdings shares rose sharply after a revised all-cash takeover proposal at NZ$3.10 per share, paired with a material downgrade to FY26 profit and net debt guidance.
why: Tourism Holdings is a New Zealand-listed campervan rental operator, and takeover proposals usually reprice shares toward the offer price.

source.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

sources.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

why_moved: A revised all-cash takeover proposal at NZ$3.10 per share offers a deal premium, even as the company cut FY26 profit and net debt guidance.
